params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

params.name: ordering
params.description: Which field to use when ordering the results.

items.docs:
#### Number of results
Use `limit` to control the number of objects in the response (max 100)

Example - [/config/launch_statuses/?limit=2](./?limit=2)

#### Format
Switch to JSON output - [/config/launch_statuses/?format=json](./?format=json)

#### Help
Find all the FAQs and support links on the documentation homepage - [ll.thespacedevs.com/docs](https://ll.thespacedevs.com/docs/)
